scientific_integrity: The rational matrix-fiber representation is cited as prior work; the claim concerns the exact ensuing all-parameter spectrum, singular spectrum, resolvent and pseudospectral boundaries. Scientific confirmation is a same-model review, not external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only universal rational rotation algebra at half-flux; no higher-denominator or irrational-flux claim. Finite numerical checks supplement rather than prove the theorem. Older equivalent nonnormal magnetic-operator formulations remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact spectra and a sharp pseudospectral-hole transition for half-flux three-term elements
